selectionBasis: Fifth cohort, selected only from RouteGadget event-list metadata (rg2api.php?type=events: name, date, club, type, suffix and world-file coefficients A-F) before downloading or viewing any image. Six regions and eight hosts never used before (Lancaster SROC, Pendle/Blackburn PFO, the British Championships server BOC for UEA Norwich, Northern Ireland LVO, Malvern HOC, Sheffield SYO, South Wales SWOC, Warwickshire/Birmingham OD), excluding Hertfordshire, London, Bristol, Oxford, Glasgow, Edinburgh, Leeds, Manchester, Newcastle and every host and place of earlier cohorts. Weighted toward Dashahe-like first maps of new places: two hilly urban parks, two campus/institutional grounds, two hilly urban sprint areas, plus two woodland/park stress cases. Events from 2023-2026 only. Eligibility: suffix gif (the verifier fetches kartat/<mapid>.gif), non-zero world file A-F whose origin lies in the event region (placeholder world files near 49.78N 7.56W, seen on BL and LOC, were excluded, as were NWO files with an origin near 78.9N 169.9E), map id not shared with another chosen event. Reasons come from the event name, club, date and world-file scale plus public knowledge of the named place, not from any image. No outcome-based replacement is allowed.
referencePolicy: World files frame a bounded teacher viewport only and measure the result afterwards. Preserve every result including refusals and wrong fits.

cases.name: Spring Series 1 Williamson Park
cases.reason: Lancaster hilltop Victorian urban park (Ashton Memorial on the summit, paved paths, steep wooded slopes, housing round the edges); closest analogue of Dashahe. World file 0.54 m/px.

cases.name: Corporation Park
cases.reason: Blackburn terraced Victorian park on a steep hillside (paved paths, lakes, conservatory, town streets around it); hilly urban park from a different Lancashire club and mapper. The same-day Corporation Park A/B events use another map id (272); this event has its own map id. World file 0.60 m/px.
